definitions: Profitable opportunities often arise from unpleasant or dirty work.
There is money to be made in industries or situations that others might find undesirable.
examples: He always says, 'where there's muck there's brass,' which is why he started a waste management company.
Don't be afraid of getting your hands dirty; where there's muck there's brass.
The old man used to tell me, 'where there's muck there's brass,' and he made a fortune in scrap metal.
